diagnostics.message: aws_lambda_function.ami_housekeeper defines a vpc_config (subnet_ids/security_group_ids) but has no dependency on aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.ami_housekeeper_vpc_execution_role. When Lambda creates a function in a VPC it assumes the execution role to create network interfaces; if the AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole policy is not yet attached to aws_iam_role.ami_housekeeper, function creation fails with 'The provided execution role does not have permissions to call CreateNetworkInterface on EC2'. Both resources only reference var.lambda_subnet_ids, so nothing orders the policy attachment before the function. Add an explicit dependency (or otherwise ensure the attachment is applied first).
